subject: P2 WCAG: G4 grade badge white-on-green = 2.07:1 FAIL in arena mode
body:
P2 WCAG BUG: G4 badge white-on-green fails 3:1 in arena (dark) mode

File: shared/styles.css + exam.html
WCAG criterion: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) — large text 3:1, normal text 4.5:1

CURRENT BEHAVIOR
exam.html line 64-65:
  .saas-grade { color: white; }
  .saas-grade.g4 { background: var(--color-correct); }

In light mode: --color-correct = #1B7D3A -- white on #1B7D3A = 5.02:1 PASS ✅
In arena mode: --color-correct = #2ECC71 -- white on #2ECC71 = 2.07:1 FAIL ❌

Grade badge: font-size: var(--text-lg) = 20px at font-weight: 800
Large text threshold: 18px+ or 14px+ bold. Badge qualifies as large text.
Large text minimum: 3:1 contrast. 2.07:1 fails by 0.93 points.

WHAT KAI SEES
In arena mode: "Grade 4" text in white on bright green — hard to read,
especially for Kai's ADHD where visual clarity drives engagement.

FIX: Two options (GD recommends Option A)

Option A — use dark text in dark mode for g4 badge:
Add to body.arena-mode block in shared/styles.css:
  .saas-grade.g4 { color: var(--color-correct-bg); }
  /* --color-correct-bg in arena mode = #0D2818 = dark green */
  /* #0D2818 on #2ECC71: contrast ~ 8.5:1 ✅ */

Option B — darken color-correct in arena mode:
  Change: --color-correct: #2ECC71
  To: --color-correct: #17A34A  (white on #17A34A = 3.57:1 ✅ for large text)
  Risk: affects correct-answer UI everywhere in dark mode (border, bg, icons)

Recommend Option A: surgical fix, no downstream side effects.
